_about: Deadline-day text (Stage 6.6, src/sim/career/deadline.ts). Fills: {player} {first} {pos} {aPos} ("an attacking midfielder") {club} (the other club) {rival} (the club trying a hijack) {fee} {wage} {person} (the caller) {short} (your club) {hour}. Each list is drawn from at random. Callers' gender is never stated.

open.pre: The pre-season window shuts tonight at 23:00. The war room is set up: phones charged, whiteboard wiped, coffee on. Take the calls yourself, or leave it to the staff.
open.mid: The mid-season window shuts tonight at 23:00. The war room is set up: phones charged, whiteboard wiped, coffee on. Take the calls yourself, or leave it to the staff.

title: Late bid for {player}
{club} want {player}
Bid in for {player}
text: {person} from {club} is on the line: {fee} for {player}, today only.
{club} have come in late for {player}. {fee}, and they want an answer before they look elsewhere.
"We both know how today works," says {person} at {club}. {fee} for {player}.
lateBid.raised: {club} sigh, then go up to {fee}. Their offer stands for another hour.
lateBid.walked: {club} won't go higher and hang up.
lateBid.lapsed: {club} gave up waiting and moved on.

title: {club} need cash
Bargain at {club}?
{club} are selling
text: {club} have bills to pay. {person} offers {player} ({pos}) for {fee}, well under his value, if it's done tonight.
{person} at {club} sounds tired: "{player}, {fee}, no haggling. We need the money by midnight."
A fire sale at {club}: {player} ({pos}) is yours for {fee}. He'd want {wage} a season.
panicSale.lapsed: {club} found a buyer elsewhere, or got tired of waiting.

title: An agent calls about {player}
Free agent: {player}
{player} is available
text: {person}, an agent, has {aPos} without a club: {player}. No fee, {wage} a season, and he can be at the training ground tomorrow.
"I've got just the player for you," says {person}. {player} ({pos}) is a free agent and wants {wage} a season.
{person} represents {player}, {aPos} who's been training alone for weeks. He's yours for {wage} a season.

title: {rival} close in on {player}
Hijack chance: {player}
{player} is about to sign for {rival}
text: Word from the scouts: {rival} are about to sign {player} ({pos}) from {club} for {fee}. {club} would take more from you. Move now or he's gone.
{player} is having his medical at {rival} as we speak. {club} would rather sell to you at {beat}.
{person} at {club} tips you off: {rival} have agreed {fee} for {player}. Beat it, at {beat}, in the next hour and he's yours.
hijack.accepted: You snatch {player} from under {rival}'s noses for {beat}.
hijack.gone: {rival}'s deal for {player} collapsed in the end.

flavour.title: A cousin calls
flavour.text: {person} says they're the cousin of a famous international and that he'd love to play for {short}. The famous international has never heard of {short}.
flavour.yesResult: You write the number on a napkin. The napkin goes in the bin at midnight.
flavour.noResult: You hang up. The phone rings again straight away. You don't answer.

flavour.title: Fax machine
flavour.text: Someone has faxed a transfer request to the war room. Nobody knew the club still had a fax machine.
flavour.yesResult: It's from a youth player asking for a move to the first team. Bold. You pass it to the academy.
flavour.noResult: The fax machine goes quiet. A historic moment for the club.

flavour.title: Reporter outside
flavour.text: A reporter from the local paper is outside the window with a sign saying "ANY NEWS?"
flavour.yesResult: Tomorrow's paper: "Owner waves, refuses to deny anything."
flavour.noResult: The blinds come down. The sign now says "PLEASE".

flavour.title: Pizza order
flavour.text: {person} from the kit room asks what everyone wants on the pizzas. It's going to be a long night.
flavour.yesResult: Morale in the war room rises. So does the bill, slightly.
flavour.noResult: The staff drink their fourth coffee in silence.

flavour.title: Wrong number
flavour.text: A caller asks if this is the bakery. It is not the bakery.
flavour.yesResult: You promise them a sourdough by Friday. Someone will have to deal with that.
flavour.noResult: They apologise and hang up. A rare easy call today.

flavour.title: Video highlights
flavour.text: {person}, an agent, has emailed a highlights reel of a winger. Every clip is the same goal from different angles.
flavour.yesResult: It's a very good goal. It is also, you notice, against a team of under-12s.
flavour.noResult: Deleted. The agent emails it again within a minute.

flavour.title: The head coach pops in
flavour.text: {coach} pops in to say they'd "love a left-footer" and leaves again before anyone can ask who.
flavour.yesResult: The scouts produce a list of left-footers. It's long. Nobody reads it.
flavour.noResult: You carry on. The head coach sends a text: "or a right-footer, either is fine".

flavour.title: Rival owner's text
flavour.text: {person} sends a text from another club: "Busy day? 😄". It's hard to tell if they mean it kindly.
flavour.noResult: They stay on read. You feel a small, petty satisfaction.

closed.title: The window has shut
closed.busy: The window shut at 23:00. In: {ins}. Out: {outs}.
closed.quiet: The window shut at 23:00 with no business done.
closed.staff: The staff ran the war room for you.
